primary_sources.source: Published examples of the phonologists and dialectologists that the specs cite
primary_sources.provenance: Each row names the page it came from. Small N, and bound by the conventions of each source and by the editor-supplied Arabic harakat (see the dataset README). It diagnoses rules and does not certify a language alone.

arabic_tts.source: LLM-generated Arabic TTS sentences, scored against their llm-corrected file
arabic_tts.provenance: A language model drafted the rows. The correction tool wrote a new label for each row: two blind passes from the text and the cited sources of the lect, and a third pass that decides where they differ, with the engine output in view. No lexicon and no rule system is behind the label.

gold20_arabic.source: LLM-generated Arabic sentences, scored against their llm-corrected file
gold20_arabic.provenance: Same correction process as arabic_tts. A native speaker spot-checked the set. That raises confidence, not the tier.

portuguese_tts.source: LLM-generated Portuguese TTS sentences, scored against their llm-corrected file

spain_romance_tts.source: LLM-generated Spain Romance TTS sentences, scored against their llm-corrected file
spain_romance_tts.provenance: Same correction process as arabic_tts. The source rows were also pinned to the output of the engine.

ep_dialects.provenance: Manual transcription by the TigreGotico team. Not validated externally. Small N.

mirandese_g2p.provenance: Collected from native speakers. Small N.

4catac.provenance: Expert annotators, IEC guidelines, consensus review.

clup_dialect.source: University of Porto CLUP dialect archive
clup_dialect.provenance: The provenance of the IPA column is not documented. Many rows have N of 1 to 17.

cmudict.provenance: Hand-curated ARPABET, mapped to IPA by a mechanical table.

ipadict.provenance: Mixed provenance: human dictionaries, Wiktionary scrapes, rule scripts and espeak output (en-GB). The tier is set per language in PROVENANCE_BY_LANG. This value is the fallback for an unclassified language, so it is the most pessimistic tier.

portuguese_unified.source: Infopedia, Michaelis and pt.wiktionary pronunciation lexicon
portuguese_unified.provenance: The mix differs by region and the tier is set per region in _PT_UNIFIED_PROVENANCE. This value is the fallback and is the more pessimistic tier.

portuguese_unified_corrected.source: portuguese_unified with the committed stress and headword overlay
portuguese_unified_corrected.provenance: Keeps the tier of the base, per language. Never gates, because it is a corrections overlay.

portal_lupo.source: Portal da Lingua Portuguesa Dicionario Fonetico
portal_lupo.provenance: Output of the LUPo rule-based generator (Ashby et al. 2012). Another G2P system.

wikipron_ar_diacritized.source: WikiPron ar, with the input word diacritized by text2tashkeel
wikipron_ar_diacritized.provenance: The gold is the crowd-scraped WikiPron gold. The machine diacritization (about 2% DER) adds a small noise floor on the input. Diagnostic for the vowelized Arabic rules.

wikipron_nor.source: WikiPron file scraped under the Norwegian macrolanguage code

wikipron_restored.source: WikiPron gold, input word read from the Wiktionary headword line
wikipron_restored.provenance: The gold IPA is byte-identical to wikipron and no new annotator or machine transcription enters.

ipa_babylm.source: IPA-BabyLM, G2P+ with the phonemizer backend, en-us
ipa_babylm.provenance: espeak-ng output. A disagreement measures divergence from espeak, a competitor.

vox_communis.provenance: Built with Epitran (a scored competitor), XPF and Charsiu. Partly hand-corrected, but not attributably.

vox_communis_corrected.source: vox_communis with the committed corrections overlay
vox_communis_corrected.provenance: A corrected gold keeps the tier of its base and never rises above it. Never gates.

ipadict_corrected.source: ipa-dict with the committed pt-BR stress overlay
ipadict_corrected.provenance: The tier is set per language from the same table as ipadict. This value mirrors the ipadict fallback.

ipa_childes.provenance: Mixed provenance: the dataset card names a different phonemizer per language (phonemizer/espeak, epitran, pinyin_to_ipa). The tier is set per language in PROVENANCE_BY_LANG. This value is the fallback, and it is a competitor tier, so it cannot gate.

hitz_basque_ipa.provenance: Output of the HiTZ ahoNT automatic phonemizer.

barranquenho_dict.source: LLM-generated Barranquenho dictionary, scored against its llm-corrected file
barranquenho_dict.provenance: Research-conditioned Claude output, then the llm-corrected process. No error model.

mirandese_dict.source: LLM-generated Mirandese dictionary, scored against its llm-corrected file
mirandese_dict.provenance: Research-conditioned Claude output, then the llm-corrected process. No error model.

northeuralex.provenance: Each row is compiled from, and cites, a published source dictionary.

wold.provenance: Each row is compiled from, and cites, a published source dictionary.

alphacep_ru_book.provenance: Automatic accentuator and G2P annotation. Morphophonemic, not surface-phonetic (see load_alphacep_ru_book).

coruss_ru.provenance: Expert phonetic transcription of recorded speech, no engine in the loop. Surface-phonetic and colloquial, so its PER floor is high (see load_coruss_ru).
